results.A01: Population = every NHL game the market prices; sample = 9,419 games 2016-17..2021-22 (SBR) + 2024-26 (DraftKings). Home teams won 54.5% vs a no-vig opener price of 54.3%: bias +0.002 (t=0.32, p=0.75). By season -0.020 to +0.022. Favorites vs their price: +0.006. The no-vig opener is close to unbiased; there's no free home or favorite lean.
results.A02: Observational: bets where the price later moved toward us (no-vig chance up 0.5+ pts) won 55.4% at an average market price of 47.0% (n=507); moved against 43.8% vs 46.1% (n=121). ROI +14.9% vs -11.3%. The move doesn't cause the win; both come from news (goalies, lineups).
results.A03: Back-to-backs (home minus away b2b): raw home win rate -0.080 per b2b (p=0.000); vs the market -0.064 (p=0.003); vs the model -0.033 (p=0.122). The raw effect is partly confounded with goalie choice (backups start b2bs), but the opener does NOT fully price it here; the shot model (which knows the likely goalie and b2b) mostly does.
results.A04: Selection on past success: teams in the top 20% for beating the moneyline in their first 41 games (+0.110 wins/game above price) were +0.020 the rest of the way; first-half vs second-half r=+0.25 (p=0.05, 64 team-seasons). 'Teams that beat the books' mostly stop.
results.A05: ROI +11.44%. SE as a simple random sample 4.13%; cluster bootstrap by game night 4.13% (ratio 1.00). Same-night bets behave as independent.
results.A06: Who's in the test set: 640 games among a home team's first 10 home games vs 1785 later. Brier early: model 0.2406, opener 0.2420; later: model 0.2387, opener 0.2400. ROI of model bets in those early games +14.7% (n=244) vs later +9.7%. Like the Literary Digest poll, a result on 'all games' can hide a subgroup the model handles differently.
results.A07: Randomization test: same 693 games, side picked by coin flip at the real opening prices, 5,000 times: mean ROI -2.57%, 99th pct +6.20%; model +11.44%. p=0.0002.
results.A08: Edge (EV) bucket as treatment, profit as response. No blocks: F=1.46, p=0.225; blocked by season: p=0.226. ROI by bucket: 6-9% +14.1% (n=261), 9-12% -2.4% (n=148), 12-20% +11.7% (n=203), 20%+ +27.7% (n=81).
results.A09: Two blocking factors (season, weekday), Latin-square idea: favorite vs underdog bets after both blocks p=0.365; weekday p=0.403.
results.A10: 2x2 factorial, favorite/underdog x home/away (response: won minus market price): ROI dog away +24.6% (n=226); dog home +7.1% (n=182); fav away +3.3% (n=67); fav home +3.8% (n=218). Interaction p=0.355.
results.A11: ANCOVA: favorite-vs-underdog gap in (won - market price) unadjusted -0.033 (p=0.391); adjusted for the price itself -0.020 (p=0.763).
results.A12: Experimental unit = game; the two team scores are measurements within it. Regulation goals above expectation correlate r=-0.06 between the two teams (slightly negative: score effects and empty nets, a team that falls behind pulls its goalie and gives up more). Counting team-games as independent would double n falsely.
results.A13: Bar chart: 77.8% of games end in regulation, 22.2% go to OT/shootout. Moneyline bets: 372 wins, 321 losses (no pushes on a moneyline).
results.A14: Pie shares of bets: dog away 33%, dog home 26%, fav away 10%, fav home 31%. Underdogs are 59% of bets: the model's value mostly lives on dogs.
results.A15: Histogram of total goals: mean 6.18, median 6, skew +0.39, excess kurtosis +0.03. Right-skewed count data with a floor at 0.
results.A16: Relative frequency of total goals: 1: 1.2%, 2: 1.4%, 3: 10.6%, 4: 8.7%, 5: 22.7%, 6: 10.8%, 7: 19.5%, 8: 7.5%, 9: 10.0%, 10: 2.9%, 11: 3.1%. At 5.5/6/6.5 lines one goal moves a total bet from loss to win; a 6 total pushes 10.8% of the time.
results.A17: Time series: moneyline ROI by month Oct +20.1% (n=117), Nov +9.2% (n=149), Dec +13.5% (n=130), Jan +10.8% (n=99), Feb +15.4% (n=39), Mar -5.8% (n=102), Apr +24.1% (n=57). Cumulative units low -2.4, high +82.3, final +79.3; worst drawdown 9.3u.
results.A18: Profit per bet: mean +0.114u, median +0.54u (every bet is either a loss of 1 or a win of 1.08 on average), 10% trimmed mean +0.042. Total goals: mean 6.18, median 6, mode 5. With dog-heavy bets, the median bet loses: the profit comes from a few big payouts.
results.A19: Quantiles of the model's EV on bets: 25th 7.8%, median 10.3%, 75th 15.2%, 95th 24.3%. Prices: median +105, 90th pct +175.
results.A20: Q-Q of standardized total-goals errors ((goals - model)/sqrt(model), the Poisson scale): Shapiro-Wilk W=0.9880, p=7.1e-12. Goals are discrete counts, so they can't be normal; use Poisson (A39) not a bell curve.
results.A21: Boxplot of total goals: Q1 5, Q3 7, IQR 2, fences 2.0 / 10.0; 4.6% of games are high outliers (10+ goals type).
results.A22: SD of profit per bet 1.086u (larger than at -110 because of dog prices). SD of total goals 2.31 vs sqrt(mean) 2.49 (what Poisson implies).
results.A23: Empirical rule on total goals: within 1 SD 69.2%, 2 SD 94.2%, 3 SD 99.8%. Discrete counts make the 68% figure lumpy.
results.A24: Coefficient of variation: total goals 37.4%, one team's goals 55.0% (NBA total: 8.8%). Hockey scores are ~5x noisier relative to their size.
results.A25: Side-by-side boxplots of (goals - opening total) by month, medians: Oct +0.5, Nov -0.5, Dec -0.5, Jan -0.5, Feb +0.5, Mar -0.5, Apr +0.5.
results.A26: Contingency table wins-losses: 2025 dog 110-122; 2025 fav 81-49; 2026 dog 89-87; 2026 fav 92-63
results.A27: Correlation of model edge (model minus no-vig opener, home side) with (home win - opener): r=+0.080 (p=0.000, n=2425).
results.A29: Break-even = 1/decimal odds. Our bets' average break-even 48.8%, actual win rate 53.7%; market's own (no-vig) chance 46.8%; model's claimed chance 54.8%. P(lose 5 straight) at a 54% win rate = 2.1%.
results.A30: Head-to-head, which probability had lower log loss per game (share for the first): model vs opener 53.2%, close vs model 50.8%, close vs opener 55.2%, blend55 vs model 46.8%, blend55 vs opener 53.2%, blend55 vs close 47.5%. Look for cycles: none means the ranking is transitive.
results.A31: Simpson check, ROI favorites vs underdogs pooled: fav +3.7%, dog +16.8%; by season 2025: fav +5.6% dog +12.0%; 2026: fav +2.2% dog +23.2%.
results.A32: Conditional probability: P(win | price moved toward us) 55.4%, P(win | no move) 58.5%, P(win | moved against) 43.8%; P(move toward us | bet) 73.2%, against 17.5%.
results.A33: Independence: same-night bet results (vs price) r=-0.016 (837 pairs); runs test 353 runs vs 346 expected, p=0.573.
results.A34: Multiplication law: two average bets (win 53.7% each, average price +105) both win 28.8% if independent. Same-game parlays are only fair if the legs are independent. Check P(over | home win) 49.5% vs P(over) 49.3%; P(over | favorite wins) 49.0% vs P(over | underdog wins) 49.6%.
results.A35: Sensitivity/specificity, 'model likes home more than the market' as a test for 'home wins': sensitivity 61.0%, specificity 43.9%. Barely better than a coin, which is expected: the market already uses most of the information.
results.A36: Bayes: with a skeptical prior on ROI (mean 0, SD 3%, i.e. most bettors have no edge) and the data (mean +11.44%, SE 4.13%), the posterior ROI is +3.96% (SD 2.43%); P(ROI > 0) = 0.949. The prior pulls a two-season record about halfway back to zero.
results.A37: At the median price (+105, decimal 2.05) and 53.7% win rate: E[X]=+0.100u, SD 1.02u. Full Kelly 9.6% of bankroll; using the market-blended probability instead (51.2%) Kelly is 4.7%.
results.A38: Wins vs the market's own chances (a 'Poisson-binomial', each bet its own p): expected 324 wins, SD 12.9; observed 372. P(at least 372) = 0.0004.
results.A39: Poisson is the natural model for hockey goals. Regulation goals per team: mean 2.98, variance 3.01 (dispersion 1.01; Poisson = 1). P(0 goals) Poisson 5.1% vs actual 5.1%; P(5+) 18.1% vs 19.2%. Rate scaling: 0.050 goals per minute -> 0.25 in a 5-minute OT for one team.
results.A40: Rare events: games with 10+ goals are 7.51%. In a 82-game team season, number of 10+ goal games ~ Binomial(82, 0.0751) ~ Poisson(6.15): P(none) 0.002 vs 0.002.
results.A41: Probability as area: P(over) = sum of the Poisson score grid above the line (plus OT). Model P(over) vs actual by quintile: 41.1%/45.9%, 45.9%/45.7%, 49.1%/47.2%, 52.5%/52.0%, 57.5%/58.1%.
results.A42: z-score of the record vs market prices: z = (wins - sum q)/sqrt(sum q(1-q)) = +3.70.
results.A43: Quantiles: with total goals ~ Poisson(model mean ~6.13), the 95th percentile is 10 goals; normal approximation gives 10.2. Observed share of games at or above 10: 7.5% (Poisson 9.3%).
results.A44: Random 300-bet samples: ROI 95% range +2.4% to +20.5%; 0.9% negative (understates risk; see A45).
results.A45: SE of ROI = 1.086/sqrt(693) = 4.13%; one season (~346 bets) SE 5.84% vs ROI +11.44%: one season is 2.0 SEs from zero.
results.A46: CLT: units per 50-bet block (13 blocks) mean +4.77, SD 4.66 (theory 7.68), skew +0.20, Shapiro p=0.85.
results.A47: Normal approximation with continuity correction using the average market chance 0.468: P(X >= 372) ~ 0.0002 (simulation in A38: 0.0004).
results.B48: Point estimates: ROI +0.1144u/bet; win rate 0.5368; model total-goals bias +0.046 goals/game; opener total bias +0.181.
results.B50: Bets needed for ROI +/-2% (95%): (1.96 x 1.09/0.02)^2 = 11,331; +/-5%: 1,813. Dog-heavy betting is noisier than NBA -110 bets (SD 1.09 vs 0.95).
results.B51: H0 ROI <= 0 vs Ha ROI > 0: t=2.77, one-sided p=0.0028. In-sample (these seasons shaped the 6% rule).
results.B52: Power for a true +4% ROI: 300 bets 16%, 693 bets 25%; 80% power needs ~4,600 bets. For +8%: 1,150.
results.B53: p-values here: permutation 0.0002, simulation vs market 0.0004, t-test 0.0028. Each is P(this good | no edge), on seasons that helped pick the rule.
results.B54: t distribution: df=692, t(0.975)=1.963. One-sample t on (won - market price): mean +0.069, t=3.68.
results.B55: Pooled t: ROI favorites +3.7% (n=285) vs underdogs +16.8% (n=408): t=-1.57, p=0.118.
results.B56: Welch t (variances differ: dog profits swing more, SD 1.23 vs 0.84): t=-1.67, p=0.096. Bets on a team on a back-to-back (won - price -0.025, n=62) vs rested (+0.078): p=0.113.
results.B57: Paired t on per-game log loss (opener minus model; positive = model better): +0.0030, t=+1.37, p=0.171; close minus model -0.0041, p=0.049.
results.B58: F test, variance of total goals Oct-Dec (5.29) vs Feb-Apr (5.51): F=0.960, p=0.521.
results.B59: One-way ANOVA, (goals - opening total) across months: F=2.19, p=0.041. Means: Oct +0.36, Nov -0.16, Dec +0.16, Jan +0.09, Feb +0.36, Mar +0.25, Apr +0.37. Model bets' profit by month: p=0.643.
results.B60: ANOVA assumptions: Brown-Forsythe/Levene equal-variance p=0.402, Bartlett p=0.135; residuals are discrete counts but n is large, so the F test is robust.
results.B61: Transformation: for Poisson counts the square root stabilizes the variance. Var of total goals by opener: 5.5: 5.28, 6.0: 5.59, 6.5: 5.38; var of sqrt(goals): 5.5: 0.227, 6.0: 0.264, 6.5: 0.226.
results.B62: Planned contrast early (Oct-Dec) minus late (Feb-Apr) in (goals - opener): -0.205 goals, t=-1.88, p=0.061.
results.B63: Orthogonal contrasts: early-vs-late SS 19.4 of SSB 72.5; the remaining month-to-month SS is spread across the other 5 orthogonal pieces.
results.B67: Tukey HSD, all 21 month pairs: 0 significant; smallest adjusted p=0.069.
results.B66: Fisher's LSD: 4 of 21 month pairs at unadjusted 5% (only allowed if the overall F is significant; here p=0.041).
results.B68: Scheffe bar for an after-the-fact contrast: t > 3.55; best-minus-worst month t=2.75: doesn't clear it.
results.B69: One proportion: win rate 53.7% (Wilson 95% CI 50.0%-57.4%) vs the market's average chance for these bets 46.8%. Games over the opening total: 49.2%, under 49.6%.
results.B70: Sample size for a win rate at +/-2% (p~0.45): 2,377 bets; +/-3%: 1,057.
results.B71: Two proportions: win rate 2024-25 52.8% vs 2025-26 54.7% (market chance 46.0% / 47.7%): z=-0.51, p=0.613.
results.B72: Fisher's exact, long shots (+200 or longer, 34 bets) home vs away: away 9-18; home 4-3; p=0.387. Long-shot record 38.2% vs market 28.6%, ROI +27.9%.
results.B73: Chi-square goodness of fit, REGULATION total goals vs Poisson at the model's game-by-game mean: chi2=35.9, df=10, p=8.69e-05. Observed/expected: 0:7/7, 1:23/39, 2:114/113, 3:177/222, 4:377/328, 5:385/388, 6:438/385, 7:298/329, 8:257/246, 9:167/164, 10:182/204. FINAL totals are a different story: every regulation tie adds exactly one goal (OT or shootout winner), so finals are odd 67.8% of the time vs 45.6% in regulation. A plain Poisson on final goals would misprice every total.
results.B74: Chi-square independence: season x win p=0.667; month x overtime p=0.814 (OT rate by month Apr:21%, Dec:20%, Feb:21%, Jan:22%, Mar:24%, Nov:24%, Oct:23%).
results.B75: Odds ratio of winning, price moved toward us vs against: 1.60 (95% CI 1.07-2.38). Note the price itself changes: what matters is won 55.4% vs market 47.0% and 43.8% vs 46.1%.
results.B76: Least squares: (home win - no-vig opener) = -0.006 + 0.775 x (model - opener) (SE 0.196, p=0.000). Slope 1 = the model's disagreements are fully right; 0.78 means trust about 78% of them (live blend: 55%). Totals: (goals - opener) on (model - opener) slope 0.92 (SE 0.10, p=0.000).
results.B77: R^2 of (home win - opener) on edge: 0.0064. Brier-style 'R^2' of probabilities: model 0.0365, opener 0.0311, close 0.0445. Hockey is close to a coin flip; even the close explains ~4%.
results.B79: Prediction vs extrapolation: at edge +3 pts the expected (win - market) is +0.018 (CI -0.003 to +0.039); a single game is win or lose (prediction interval covers everything). Edges of 15+ pts (0.6% of games) are outside where the fit has data.
results.B80: Cook's distance: 45 games above 4/n, max 0.0051; slope without them 0.966 vs 0.775.
results.B81: Multiple regression of (home win - opener): edge +0.655 (p=0.001), b2b_diff -0.045 (p=0.047), fav_h -0.016 (p=0.462). R^2 0.0082.
results.B82: Studentized residuals: 0.0% beyond |2|; max |t| 1.70. A binary response has bounded residuals (upsets of big favorites are the 'outliers'), so a linear model is a rough tool here; B98 is the right one.
results.B83: Residual Q-Q: bimodal (win/lose), Q-Q correlation 0.896. Normal-error inference is still fine for the slope at n=2425 by the CLT, but use logistic regression for probabilities.
results.B84: Homoscedasticity: Breusch-Pagan p=0.009 (binary outcome: variance p(1-p) is highest for even games, as expected). Totals: spread of (goals - opener) vs the opener p=0.844. Durbin-Watson 1.985.
results.B86: Added-variable plot for back-to-backs: slope -0.045 (p=0.047) after removing edge and favorite status.
results.B87: Spread-level: SD of (goals - opener) by opening total 5.5: 2.30 (n=1137), 6.0: 2.36 (n=148), 6.5: 2.32 (n=1137); log-log slope 0.06 (Poisson predicts 0.5 -> square-root transform, B61).
results.B88: VIF with raw probabilities as predictors: p_home 5.6, nv_open 7.1, nv_close 8.5. The model, opener and close all measure 'how good is the home team'; working with differences (edge, move) removes it: edge 1.3, move 1.3.
results.B89: Box-Cox on (total goals + 1): lambda = 0.58 (0.5 = square root, as Poisson theory says).
results.B90: Box-Tidwell, opener chance as a predictor of home wins: x*log(x) term p=0.552 (linear in the market's chance is fine across this range).
results.B91: Deleting observations: dropping the 5% longest-priced bets (>= +196) changes ROI +11.4% -> +10.8%. The record doesn't hinge on a few long shots.
results.B92: Interaction edge x home favorite: +0.294 (p=0.476); edge slope when home is the dog 0.576, when favorite 0.870.
results.B94: Nested F: adding back-to-back and favorite terms to edge: F=2.15, p=0.117.
results.B95: AIC/BIC (logistic, home win), 2024-26: opener only AIC 3271.3 BIC 3282.9; model only AIC 3256.2 BIC 3267.8; opener + model AIC 3257.6 BIC 3274.9. In these two seasons the model alone beats the opener (lower AIC) and adding the opener doesn't help.
results.B97: Adjusted R^2: edge only 0.0060; + b2b + favorite 0.0070.
results.B98: Logistic regression, home win on logit(opener) and logit(model): coefficients opener 0.170 (p=0.43), model 0.775 (p=7.89e-05). Implied weight on the model 82% (live blend uses 55%).
results.X01: Overs (live v1.1 rule, EV >= 6% at the open): 2024-26 198 bets, 54.0%, +6.1u (+3.1%); closing total rose after 35.9% of bets, fell 8.1% (all games: 16.5% / 15.5%).
results.X02: Market-only rule, back the rested team against a team on a back-to-back at the opening price: 2024-26 538 bets, +41.9u (+7.8%), won 59.7% vs price 53.5%. By season 2025: +12.7% (price move +0.023), 2026: +2.5% (price move +0.024).
results.B64: 41 hypothesis tests. Raw p<0.05: 17 (A03, A04, A07, A20, A27, A38, B51, B54, B59, B69, B73, B75, B76, B78, B81, B86, B98); ~2.1 expected by chance. After Benjamini-Hochberg: A03, A07, A20, A27, A38, B51, B54, B69, B73, B76, B78, B81, B98.
